description: A configuration file, as TOML text, loaded into the values it gives or the keys it gets wrong. Keys are compared byte for byte; a problem names its key, never its wording.

cases.note: the two required keys: everything else takes its default; strategy and avoid_hotter_than stay unset
the same key, once through an escape
a table extended by a dotted key: BurntSushi accepts this, go-toml and Rust refuse it
not valid UTF-8 in a value
not valid UTF-8 in a comment
a line ending in a bare CR
a byte order mark that is not the first thing in the file
only one byte order mark is ignored
a leading byte order mark is ignored
TOML 1.1: a trailing comma in an inline table
TOML 1.1: an inline table over several lines
a quoted key is the same key
a key through an escape is the same key
disks and rules may interleave; each list keeps its own order
